title: VNFC causal one-deviation R03 card
context: Claim: an exact finite same-information one-deviation class may expose material native R_fail_60 headroom above BCRH on the unchanged sixteen-world host. Binding structure: roster change after unannounced executor loss. The card implements the exact PRO_FINAL successor, with absolute MEI 0.10, no learner exposure, one result-blind calibration and at most one remote result.

options.label: Accept the frozen R03 card
options.consequence: CM implements the exact card and the admitted loop may continue without waiting.

options.label: Reject and do not launch R03
options.consequence: No R03 result is launched; the direction returns to Root/owner without rewriting evidence.

options.label: Revise before further execution
options.consequence: Stop before result launch and apply the owner's specified card change at the next clean boundary.

dm_reason: It is the smallest class-correct object specified by the final Convergence response and preserves all scientific boundaries.

packet.question: 是否接受并继续执行 Pro 已选定的 VNFC 因果单次偏离 R03 A/RECON 卡片？

changes_if_approved.from: 特权完整未来带的 K256/K1024 宽度下界
changes_if_approved.to: 同一 host、同一十六世界、同信息的 BCRH 单次因果偏离有限策略类

packet.if_refused: 不启动 R03；K256/K1024 结果与 MB1024-D 解释保持不变，方向返回 owner/Root 决定下一步。

evidence_for.quote: The smallest supported continuation is to retain the exact native host, sixteen-world population, R_fail_60 endpoint, and delta_fail=0.10, while replacing the information-asymmetric physical-headroom bracket with a finite same-information causal policy-improvement estimand around BCRH-PERSIST.
evidence_for.why: 这是完整的 direction-tier PRO_FINAL，对后继对象给出唯一具体定义。

evidence_for.quote: The fourfold width increase resolves one predecessor pruning loss but does not resolve the panel-wide headroom bracket.
evidence_for.why: 有效 R02 支持停止继续加宽，并把可因果选择性作为更近的未决因素。

evidence_against.quote: Even CI-A can establish only an in-panel deterministic lookup-map ceiling for a one-deviation class.
evidence_against.why: 结果的外推范围很窄，且不能建立 learner competence 或 unrestricted causal optimum。

uncertainty: 完整有限 census 的 conservative wall projection 需由 result-blind calibration 给出。
因果 history class 是否可由现有公开字段无歧义定义需 CM 直接验证。
全 panel 既用于策略选择又用于测量，因此没有 held-out/generalization 含义。

cost.compute: 一次低于 60 秒的 result-blind calibration；若投影低于 2700 秒，再允许一次 remote-first 结果调用。
cost.owner_time: 无需等待；可异步接受、拒绝或要求修订。
cost.waits_on_this: 不等待 owner；CM 技术接受和 fresh remote admission 仍是运行前边界。
